data: synthetic: a queue-reactive simulator with made-up parameters, no market data
bounds: One synthetic simulator, made-up parameters and 24 days per regime bound what this comparison can show.
origin: The days, digests and splits of #102 (experiments/m4_05, 10 s rows), read from its digests; plus shocked copies of the validation and holdout days, digested in shocks.json before any training.
holdout_rule: Holdout rows are generated only to fix their digests here, and are written apart. No run reads them until every checkpoint and configuration is frozen and its hash recorded.

shocks.what: an asset shock in the sense of margin-rs Scenario::shock: from 12:00 of the day on, the bid and the ask move by round(mid * shock) ticks of the kernel, the spread and sizes unchanged
shocks.use: the stress rows of the evaluation, apart from the unshocked days; never used for training

execution.fee_rate: by the rule of #103 (experiments/m4_06), on #102's training days at this execution; chosen in the fee_rule step and recorded
execution.limits_from_margin: max_notional = initial capital / maintenance rate = 125 / 0.05 = 2500; the kernel's RiskLimits are the only gate on this path and stay the final authority for every arm (the margin gate is not wired into the kernel: #283)

costs.c_inventory: max(0, |q| - 5) / 15 per step, q the delivered position after the step
costs.c_notional: |q| * mid / 2500 per step, mid of the observed row
costs.c_margin: a declared proxy: the margin-rs rule linear-im/1 maintenance requirement 0.05 * |q| * mid, over equity 125 + net, capped at 1 (equity at or below 0 is 1)
costs.constrained_cost: c_inventory + c_notional, with a cost limit per episode of (0.05 + 0.2) * steps of the day
costs.reported: each cost apart, mean per step per episode, against its budget; c_margin is reported, not constrained

ppo_penalized.reward: the kernel's reward minus lambda * (c_inventory + c_notional) per step
ppo_penalized.selection: on validation: the best mean daily net among the lambdas whose mean cost per step is within the budget; if none is, the lowest cost

ppo_lagrangian.config: standardized_rew_adv false, standardized_cost_adv false; the rest as the toy gate (experiments/m4_08/toy_gate.json)

arms.failed_gate: OmniSafe PPOLag with its default configuration failed the toy gate and is not an arm

training_days: each learned run trains on the pooled training days of every regime; every reset draws one of those days from the run's seed

evaluation.daily_value: a day's exact net result; a learned arm's day is the mean over its training seeds

metrics: mean cost per step against each budget
decisions refused by the hard limits, by reason

decision_rule.constrained_better: for ppo_lagrangian and for cpo, against ppo_penalized, paired 90 % block bootstrap over days: the daily net interval includes or is above 0 and the daily constrained cost interval is below 0, with no breach
decision_rule.also: every learned arm against no_trade and against ppo, the same way; nothing here is a safety guarantee

venv.omnisafe: experiments/m4_08/omnisafe-lock.txt (Python 3.11.17; MUJOCO_GL=disable; gymnasium-robotics removed); the bridge built at abi3-py311 (#284)

compute.overrun_rule: a step that overruns its estimate by more than 50 % stops and is reported, without cutting seeds

steps.name: pilot
steps.what: 50000 steps of each OmniSafe algorithm on training days, to time them

steps.name: training
steps.what: ppo, ppo_lagrangian, cpo x 5 seeds, and ppo_penalized x 3 lambdas x 5 seeds
